last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 12
last_episode_to_air.overview: Penelope keeps Argyri and Telemachus on their toes as she not-so-sneakily investigates the murder of an ophthalmologist despite her ordered maternity leave by Sophia. The murder case is due but so is Penelope yet she finds herself against all odds once again.

name: IQ 160
overview: An unconventional woman, but with extraordinary intelligence but no one could have imagined it, and a quirky police officer, who suddenly has to work with her to solve crimes!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Penelope Mouriki (Smaragda Karydi) works as a cleaner at a police station, in the Crimes Against Life Directorate of the Greek Police. One night, she accidentally comes across the details of a recent murder case. She reads them and intervenes in the conclusions of the investigation, making very important corrections. The next morning, Lieutenant Argyris Kalatzis (Nikos Kouris) and the head of the department, Sofia Charitaki (Marouska Panagiotopoulou) discover her intervention, call her in for an explanation and are in for a big surprise. They find that Penelope is endowed with very high intelligence and has an IQ of 160! The chief, impressed by Penelope's abilities, forces the reluctant police lieutenant Kalatzis to collaborate with the talented cleaner.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The 3rd season of IQ 160 is coming to Star and... it contains explosive dangers, humor, twists, a police mystery, laughter, love and... a baby!
